title: Italian Fibonacci controlled model comparison
description: Run Italian Fibonacci as a controlled product exercise through the accepted STARCHART rail, comparing isolated Luna and Sol candidates from one frozen SPEC and delivering a self-contained public product-plus-receipts bundle.
design: Two isolated implementation transactions receive identical inputs; a separate verification unit compares correctness, process, accounting, and provenance without changing the accepted STARCHART runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Independent Quality accepts a canonical product; raw Beads and transaction records, available accounting, process notes, reproducible verification, final artifacts, manifest links, and SHA-256 digests form a distribution-quality evidence directory.
